plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S4, a secret site near Area 51 in Nevada, is said to have got that job with help from John Lear, a longtime figure in UFO circles. The researcher UAPGerb says Lear is on record in an interview saying he helped get Lazar the S4 job. Jesse Michels retells it from that interview with more detail. In his version, Lear says a Navy admiral at "MJ level" came to him. Michels explains that MJ in UFO lore means the elite committee said to govern the whole subject. The admiral said they had to "get Bob on the job" because they could hide his role. If true, it would mean Lazar was placed at S4 on purpose by insiders, which would help explain his story.
